Start a project

Tell me what you need.

Choose the way that suits you best. No account, no sign-up. The first call is free, takes about 30 minutes and commits you to nothing.

How would you like to start?

You are offline. Your input is kept; send it when the connection is back, or call.

Project estimate

A rough price and timeline in a few clicks. The final quote always comes after a call, in writing, before any commitment.

The estimate needs JavaScript. Without it, send a quick enquiry below — I will reply with a rough price.

    What are we building?

    Pick the closest option. If you are not sure, that is an answer too.

    What should it do?

    Pick as many as you like, or skip.

    No problem. Describe your work in the enquiry and we will define the scope together on the call.

    How many people will use it?

    Count yourself and your staff, not your clients.

    When do you need it?

    The timeline decides the order we build things in, not only the price.

    Rough budget?

    It helps me suggest the right first version. “Not sure yet” is perfectly fine.

      What happens next
      1. I read your enquiry personally and reply with a suggested time for a call.
      2. On the call (about 30 min, free) we look at how you work and what makes sense.
      3. You get a written quote: scope, timeline and price. You pay nothing until you accept it.
